purpose: Check a necessary capacity condition for phase-independent decoding and autonomous SHA round updates; not an obfuscation benchmark
hypothesis: Eight phase encodings with a common full-state decoder and common zero-W update require at least 259 bits
primary_check: Every target is reached at every phase with current W=0; successors at distinct phases differ
secondary_check: Complete Python SHA output agrees with hashlib for all constructed messages
negative_control: Change inverse d=E-t1 to d=E+t1, record incorrect inverse count without presuming all inputs detect it
decision: Reject only the common-decoder 256-bit carrier model if the algebraic bound holds; finite checks do not prove the universal bound
